features: 【🖱️ Built-In Touch Pad】 Acer FoldTouch Pro combines a 64-key folding keyboard with an integrated touch pad, providing keyboard and touch-pad functionality in one compact device for compatible laptops, tablets and other supported devices.

【📶 Bluetooth 5.0 & 3-Channel Connectivity】 Equipped with Bluetooth 5.0, the keyboard supports 3 Bluetooth connection channels and wireless transmission up to 10 m, allowing connection with compatible Bluetooth-enabled devices.

【🔄 Foldable & Compact Design】 Designed with ABS + PU material, the keyboard measures 250.5 × 182 × 7.5 mm when open and 250.5 × 91 × 16 mm when folded. Its Space Grey finish complements its compact folding form.

【🔋 500mAh Rechargeable Battery】 Features a built-in 500mAh rechargeable battery with approximately 200 hours of working time and more than 6 months of standby time. USB-C charging is supported, with an approximate 2-hour charging time.

【💻 Wide OS Compatibility & 5M Key Life】 Compatible with Windows 8.0 and above, macOS 10.10 and above, Android 4.3 and above, and iOS 13.4 and above. The keyboard has a specified key life of up to 5 million keystrokes.
